method_repair: Apply backward-only price, history, and ADV eligibility before reporting-lag quintile assignment.

signal_definition.entry: second regular XNYS open of formation month
signal_definition.exit: second regular XNYS open of following month
signal_definition.portfolio: 100 percent NAV long fastest quintile and 100 percent NAV short slowest quintile

multiplicity.reason: The design repair was chosen after observing Stage A outcomes; all output is descriptive.

hard_claim_limits: This is a post-outcome method-repair diagnostic, not an independent confirmation.
The universe is selected from 2026 survivors and lacks permanent security identities and delisting returns.
Historical accelerated-filer status and contemporaneous market capitalization are unavailable.
Yahoo adjusted opens and dollar volume are retrospective proxies.
Borrow, financing and TAQ impact are absent.
No 2025 signal outcome may be joined.
